thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU pool 'prod-gpus' queue length alarm triggered (gpu_queue_len > 700 for 5m). Paging liam-sre (primary).

liam-sre: on it. jumping into infra dashboard and k8s.

anya-ml: noticed error spikes in model-serving gateway 02:03Z, high 5xx and request timeouts. queue length showing sustained growth.

liam-sre: `kubectl get hpa -n inference serve-gpu` shows current 6 / desired 6 but events say "failed to get external metrics". HPA stuck.

devops-bot: prometheus-adapter in monitoring namespace reporting `503 Service Unavailable` to k8s custom metrics endpoint; recent pod restarts detected (2x in last 10m).

anya-ml: I've got `curl` to Prometheus returning scrape for exporter `gpu/queue` but some samples have `NaN` or empty value during heavy load. Might be exporter crashlooping during heavy memory pressure.

liam-sre: immediate steps: 1) manually scale deployment to relieve queue, 2) restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server, 3) apply temporary pod disruption budget to avoid thrashing. Starting manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy/serve-gpu -n inference --replicas=30`

devops-bot: Scaling accepted, replicas target set to 30.

alex-cs: CS: customers seeing increased latency and occasional 429s from rate limiter. Two enterprise tenants reported degraded throughput. Preparing communication.

liam-sre: manual scale in progress. Watching queue: 02:10Z queue peak ~1500, 02:16Z down to ~420. Throughput recovering.

anya-ml: restarting prometheus-adapter now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`

devops-bot: prometheus-adapter rollout started. Also restarting metrics-server: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-server -n kube-system`

liam-sre: adapter healthy now. However HPA still reporting errors: `unable to fetch external metric gpu_queue_len: no metrics returned`.

anya-ml: found stacktrace in adapter logs: `panic: strconv.ParseFloat: parsing "\n": invalid syntax` when parsing exporter output. The exporter emitted a blank line for a gauge under GC pause.

liam-sre: that explains parse errors. For now HPA will not use the metric reliably. I'm going to patch HPA to use resource metric (cpu) temporarily: `kubectl patch hpa serve-gpu -n inference --type='json' -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics","value":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":60}}}] } ]'`

devops-bot: patch applied; HPA now using CPU util. Will allow autoscale while adapter is fixed.

alex-cs: sent initial customer update at 02:22Z: "We're investigating autoscaling delays causing latency; mitigation in place, services recovering, follow-up forthcoming."

liam-sre: we're keeping manual replica target for 15 minutes to ensure backlog drains, then revert to HPA-with-cpu. Recording all commands in incident log.

anya-ml: long-term fixes: exporter should never emit blank values; add validation and backoff in exporter, adapter should treat blank as missing rather than erroring out. Opening ticket now. Also recommend synthetic scrape monitoring for exporter with alert on invalid/missing samples.

oncall-handoff: schedule handoff in 40m to next shift @mira-sre. Please include runbook steps and exact commands used.

liam-sre: handoff notes: timeline, manual scale commands, adapter restart, HPA patch to CPU, customer comms. Current state: queue ~80, replicas 18 (manual override), HPA with CPU active and stable.

anya-ml: created bug: INFR-4583 "gpu-exporter emits blank sample -> prometheus-adapter parse error -> HPA stalls" assigned to eng-ml, severity P1 for follow-up and patch.

devops-bot: alert suppressed; monitoring in recovery mode.

alex-cs: customers notified via status page update at 02:30Z, included mitigation steps and expected timeline for RCA. No data confidentiality issues.

liam-sre: prepare post-incident actions: 1) add adapter healthcheck that fails on blank samples, 2) add HPA fallback policy (prefer resource metrics if external metric missing), 3) increase exporter resilience, 4) run load test to reproduce GC-induced blanks.

oncall-handoff: handing off to mira-sre at 02:46Z. All logs and runbook available in incident doc.

mira-sre: taking over. Thanks. Will watch for reoccur and coordinate RCA with eng-ml.

anya-ml: note: one of the tenants peaked with a sudden burst pattern; consider recommending dedicated capacity for very spiky customers to avoid shared pool headroom exhaustion.

liam-sre: agreed. Also propose emergency autoscale override policy to allow temporary burst above normal quota for mitigation. Adding to follow-up ticket.

oncall-handoff: status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: anya-ml.

liam-sre: :thumbsup: great work. Keep eyes on metrics overnight and update postmortem when available.
